paragraphs: Introducing React Selection Highlighter, the tool for implementing text selection highlighting in React applications with React Selection Highlighter. Developers can effortlessly enable users to highlight text within text and HTML content. This versatile component goes beyond basic highlighting by offering advanced features, such as the ability to save selections to a database; developers can reconstruct highlights and popovers at a later stage, providing users with a seamless and intuitive experience. Elevate your text selection experience with React Selection Highlighter. Whether you're building a reading app, an annotation tool, or a collaborative platform, this component has you covered.
